Hi Jordan —

Welcome — we're excited to get CloudForge onboarded. To complete supplier activation and issue a PO, Procurement needs the following items: 

1) Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing the limits below and an endorsement naming Redwood Inference, Inc. and its affiliates as Additional Insured. Please include a Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood where possible. Required minimum limits:
   - Commercial General Liability: $2,000,000 per occurrence / $4,000,000 aggregate
   - Umbrella/Excess: $3,000,000
   - Professional Liability / E&O: $2,000,000
   - Workers' Comp: statutory

2) Signed endorsement (we've attached a short endorsement template redwood_endorsement_template.pdf for legal wording). If your insurer requires alternative language, please share it and we'll review.

3) W-9 (completed) and vendor remittance info (bank ACH details or PO invoice remit address). Please mark whether CloudForge accepts net-30 or needs alternative terms.

4) Point of contact for invoicing and the name/email for CloudForge Finance (we'll CC them on the PO).

If you can provide the COI + W-9 by EOD Wednesday (PDT), Procurement/Finance will target issuing PO CF-2026-2987 by Friday.

Attachments: redwood_endorsement_template.pdf (endorsement sample)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if it's easier.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
